    <item>
  <title>FDA Approves First Treatment for Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type 2I/R9</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-treatment-limb-girdle-muscular-dystrophy-type-2ir9</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved the first medicine for treating limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9), a rare inherited muscle disease, for adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg.</description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:25:08 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-treatment-limb-girdle-muscular-dystrophy-type-2ir9</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First New Hormone Therapy for Early-Stage Breast Cancer in More Than 20 Years </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-new-hormone-therapy-early-stage-breast-cancer-more-20-years</link>
  <description>The FDA today approved Wilserdly (giredestrant), used alone after surgery in adults with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative breast cancer — the most common subtype of the disease. </description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:55:37 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-new-hormone-therapy-early-stage-breast-cancer-more-20-years</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First Drug to Treat Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease  </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-treat-neurological-symptoms-type-3-gaucher-disease</link>
  <description>FDA today approved Infilbray (venglustat) tablets, the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3) in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg (approximately 33 pounds).</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:13:26 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-treat-neurological-symptoms-type-3-gaucher-disease</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Launches the Global Reliance Disclosure Program to Expand Patient Access to Medicines Worldwide</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-global-reliance-disclosure-program-expand-patient-access-medicines-worldwide</link>
  <description>FDA  today announced the Global Reliance Disclosure Program (GRDP), a landmark initiative that will fundamentally transform how the FDA's regulatory drug and biologic approval decisions are leveraged by health authorities around the world. </description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:32:16 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-global-reliance-disclosure-program-expand-patient-access-medicines-worldwide</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First Drug Shown to Help Patients with Infantile-Onset Niemann-Pick Disease Type C Live Longer</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-shown-help-patients-infantile-onset-niemann-pick-disease-type-c-live-longer</link>
  <description>FDA approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) injection, the first treatment shown to help people with a severe form of Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) live longer.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:15:22 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-shown-help-patients-infantile-onset-niemann-pick-disease-type-c-live-longer</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First Factor Xla Inhibitor to Help Prevent Stroke in Certain Adults at High Risk  </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-factor-xla-inhibitor-help-prevent-stroke-certain-adults-high-risk</link>
  <description>FDA today approved Sunharbo (asundexian) 50 mg tablets, the first factor XIa (FXIa) inhibitor for use in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults following a recent mild-to-moderate non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or a high-risk transient ischemic attack. </description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:15:46 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-factor-xla-inhibitor-help-prevent-stroke-certain-adults-high-risk</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Grants Accelerated Approval to a New Treatment for Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-new-treatment-head-and-neck-squamous-cell-carcinoma</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today granted accelerated approval to Rybrevant Faspro (amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj) for the treatment of adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherap</description>
  <pubDate>Thu, 05 Nov 2026 17:30:38 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-new-treatment-head-and-neck-squamous-cell-carcinoma</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Provides Clarity to Support Cell and Gene Therapy Development and Quality </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-provides-clarity-support-cell-and-gene-therapy-development-and-quality</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued final guidance for manufacturers of cellular and gene therapy (CGT) products to implement a comprehensive, science- and risk-based plan for making sure their products meet potency standards. </description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:56:06 EST</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-provides-clarity-support-cell-and-gene-therapy-development-and-quality</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First Plasmid DNA-based Immunotherapy for Adults with Recurrent Respiratory Papillomatosis</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-plasmid-dna-based-immunotherapy-adults-recurrent-respiratory-papillomatosis</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today granted accelerated approval for Voceryq (doruxapapogene ralaplasmid and lalikinogene sifuplasmid-gxfd) for treatment of adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP). </description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:32:08 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-plasmid-dna-based-immunotherapy-adults-recurrent-respiratory-papillomatosis</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Launches New Program to Advance Neuroscience Medical Product Development </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-new-program-advance-neuroscience-medical-product-development</link>
  <description>FDA announces the launch of the Neuroscience Advancement and Innovation Nexus (NAIN), a new agency program aligned with the Trump Administration’s efforts to accelerate medical innovation and deliver breakthrough treatments. </description>
  <pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 12:58:19 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-new-program-advance-neuroscience-medical-product-development</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-its-kind-chronic-hepatitis-b-treatment</link>
  <description>FDA today approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection, in combination with existing antiviral therapy, to treat chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in certain adults without cirrhosis.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:40:38 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-its-kind-chronic-hepatitis-b-treatment</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves Once-Weekly Generic Hormone Therapy Patch for Women</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-once-weekly-generic-hormone-therapy-patch-women</link>
  <description>Today, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the first generic of Climara Pro (estradiol and levonorgestrel transdermal system, 0.045 mg per day/0.015 mg), a transdermal hormone therapy patch for women with an intact uterus applied once a week.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:57:36 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-once-weekly-generic-hormone-therapy-patch-women</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Issues Final Guidance on Prescription Drug Apps and Software</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-issues-final-guidance-prescription-drug-apps-and-software</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today released final guidance establishing a clear framework for how drug companies can develop, distribute, and label apps used alongside their prescription medicines.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:03:14 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-issues-final-guidance-prescription-drug-apps-and-software</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Approves Immunotherapy That May Allow Certain Patients with Rectal Cancer to Avoid Chemotherapy, Radiation and Surgery</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-immunotherapy-may-allow-certain-patients-rectal-cancer-avoid-chemotherapy-radiation-and</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today granted accelerated approval for a new use of the immunotherapy Jemperli (dostarlimab-gxly) that may allow some patients with locally advanced rectal cancer to avoid common treatments that can have a lasting impact on their daily life.</description>
  <pubDate>Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:19:38 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-immunotherapy-may-allow-certain-patients-rectal-cancer-avoid-chemotherapy-radiation-and</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>FDA Launches the Rare Disease Framework Initiative to Develop a Holistic, Fit-For-Purpose Framework for Rare Disease Drug Development</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-rare-disease-framework-initiative-develop-holistic-fit-purpose-framework-rare-disease</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration, a division within the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), today announced the Rare Disease Framework Initiative to reimagine the development of drugs and biologics for rare diseases. </description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:50:52 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-rare-disease-framework-initiative-develop-holistic-fit-purpose-framework-rare-disease</guid>
    </item>

  <title>FDA Seeks Public Input to Support Ibogaine Research</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-seeks-public-input-support-ibogaine-research</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced a request for information (RFI) describing approaches the agency is considering for the design of early-phase clinical trials of ibogaine drug products and seeking public input on those approaches. </description>

  <title>FDA Approves First Heart Valve Designed to Grow with Children</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-heart-valve-designed-grow-children</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved the Autus Size-Adjustable Valve, a surgically implanted pulmonary heart valve for pediatric patients with congenital pulmonary valve disease. </description>
  <pubDate>Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:02:08 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-heart-valve-designed-grow-children</guid>

  <title>FDA Launches Nationwide Effort to Expand Scientific Expertise and Consumer Voices to Advisory Committees</title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-nationwide-effort-expand-scientific-expertise-and-consumer-voices-advisory-committees</link>
  <description>The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced a broad, nationwide recruitment effort to expand the range of qualified voices and perspectives on its advisory committees— the independent bodies that inform some of the most consequential decisions in American public health. </description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:26:33 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="true">http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-nationwide-effort-expand-scientific-expertise-and-consumer-voices-advisory-committees</guid>
    </item>

  <title>FDA Investigation Leads to Charges Against Two Indian Nationals Involved in Transnational Counterfeit Drug Distribution Scheme </title>
  <link>http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-investigation-leads-charges-against-two-indian-nationals-involved-transnational-counterfeit-drug</link>
  <description>The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Middle District of Florida and the Criminal Division of the U.S. Department of Justice today announced federal charges against Swapnadip Roy, 33, and Vicky Ramancha, 37, both Indian nationals.</description>
  <pubDate>Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:01:07 EDT</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>FDA</dc:creator>
